title: Positive integrals of nonnegative bumps over an n-plane
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim Q = n (Module.finrank ℝ Q = n). Let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous, compactly supported and nonnegative, and let w ∈ Q with g(w) > 0. Then ∫_Q g dHⁿ > 0. Here Hⁿ = μHE[n], and ∫_Q g dHⁿ is the integral of g against the restricted measure Hⁿ⌞Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (w : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ y, 0 ≤ g y) → w ∈ Q → 0 < g w → 0 < ∫ y in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), g y ∂μHE[n]
